title: K5: the learner says they changed another layer (Row A) by mistake and undid it. No check saw it, so the saved record never pairs a change word with Row A; a refused save is rewritten and saved with no word of it to the learner

turns.say: Tile, Caption and Stamp should move together.
I added a null and put it on the group's top-left corner, since the group turns from there. Done.
I parented all three and gave the null a slide. Earlier I moved Row A by mistake and undid it. Done.

note: Spec 014 T079 (K5). The flow is case 30's, with the learner's mistake line in the last turn; Row A is a Mentor Practice 2 layer outside the group, so no check attributes anything to it. The case pins the outcome (nothing unseen in the saved record, a refused save recovered, no word of it to the learner), not that the guard fired.
